content: npx stale cache: before npm 11.2.0 npx reused the cached version for bare names and ranges and never refreshed (npm/cli 7838, rfcs 700). npm/cli PR 8100 merged Feb 2025 and shipped in npm 11.2.0: adds npm cache npx and refreshes ranges and bare names from the registry. Node 20 and 22 ship npm 10.x so many users are still affected; @latest or an explicit version pin is the workaround.
